answer: Crystal cargo on a voyage blocks bulk fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits and commits a crystal cargo to a prism checkpoint, which measures it on arrival. Each voyage delivery carries a fresh serial; auditors check it on the prism table, and a missing or reused cargo burns the bond. First delivery 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 3,037,000 for 40,000. A rented-cargo ring fails: each serial binds to its key. Honest agents pay 40 once.
